headline: Bank of Japan Division Over Rate Hike Trajectory Risks Renewed Yen Weakness
summary: Bank of Japan policymakers agree on the necessity of a December interest rate increase, but internal splits over the ultimate peak rate threaten to confuse guidance and spur fresh yen selling.
why: Uncertainty surrounding BOJ rate policies alters global currency carry trade dynamics, Japanese government bond yields, and cross-border investment flows.

impacts.name: Japanese Yen
impacts.why: Policy ambiguity regarding the long-term rate path weakens market conviction in sustained monetary tightening.
